song.title: Walk With You
song.lyrics:
[V1] .C Early in the morning . G You wait for me to rise . C counting down the seconds . G till I open up my eyes . C I hear your invitation . Am you have been so patient . C G Lord this is my reply,
[C1] . C I want to walk with you . G and talk with you . Am hear you speaking . G feel you breathing . C walk with you . G and talk with you . Am hear you speaking . G feel you breathing . C D walk with you...
[V2] . C By the quiet waters . G you fill me with your peace . C through the darkest valley . G I know that you're with me . C the beauty of your presence . Am fills me with assurance . G that you are all I need
[C2] . C I want to walk with you . G and talk with you . Am hear you speaking . G feel you breathing . C walk with you . G and talk with you . Am hear you speaking . G feel you breathing . C D walk with you...
[B1] . Em G Jesus I wanna walk with you...
[B2] . C I wanna know you . D not just about you . Em I wanna be with you . D G not just around you . C I wanna love you . D Em not just be loved by you . Am Em D I wanna walk with you . Am D I wanna walk with you . Am D I wanna walk with you
song.author: Michael Bethany
